proposals.observation: Of 2 quiz sessions in the last 48h, 1 stopped at intro_load and 1 stopped at email_shown — 0 completions. The single person who reached the email gate did not continue, suggesting the email-capture step is killing forward momentum before any value is delivered.
proposals.proposal: Move the email capture to after the final result is calculated (a post-result gate) rather than mid-quiz. Rewrite the email prompt copy to frame it as receiving a personalised breakdown rather than a sign-up ask. This removes the cold-ask friction at the point of least trust.
proposals.new_text: Your result is ready — where should we send your personalised breakdown?
proposals.impact: Reduces mid-quiz abandonment at email gate

proposals.observation: The WoW - Money Vigilance automation has the highest open rate of the three at 50% (4/8 opens) yet the smallest send volume — only 8 sends versus 15 and 16 for the other two. This segment is the most engaged but least populated, suggesting either the quiz under-routes people into this result or the result page lacks a compelling reason to continue.
proposals.proposal: Add a contextual inline CTA block to the Money Vigilance result page that speaks directly to the grounded, careful earner archetype — acknowledging the quiet awareness they already have and naming the specific work underneath (the gap between knowing and doing). Link it to a dedicated booking or waitlist page. One paragraph + one button, no new page required.

proposals.observation: The Funnel-Hack Digest GitHub Actions workflow failed on 2026-05-08T13:00:38Z and is the only failed run out of 9 total. This workflow is likely the automated content or digest pipeline; a silent failure means Joel may be missing a scheduled intelligence feed or automated post without knowing it.
proposals.proposal: Add a failure notification step to the Funnel-Hack Digest workflow that posts a plain-text summary of the failure reason to a Slack webhook or sends a GitHub issue. This is a single new step appended to the existing workflow YAML — no logic change, just an on-failure notification so the failure does not silently recur.
proposals.current_text:
- name: Run digest
        run: node scripts/funnel-hack-digest.js
proposals.new_text:
- name: Run digest
        run: node scripts/funnel-hack-digest.js

      - name: Notify on failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          curl -s -X POST "${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}" \
            -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
            --data '{"text":"⚠️ Funnel-Hack Digest workflow failed on run ${{ github.run_id }}. Check the Actions tab for details."}'
proposals.impact: Prevents silent pipeline failures going unnoticed
